# Luvia

> Luvia is an online catalogue of handmade crochet products and gifts, with shipping across India.

Luvia showcases handmade crochet hair accessories, charms, keychains, bags,
toys, festive decor, rakhi and anklets. Products may have multiple colour
variants and are handmade to order. Customers can view the current catalogue
and contact Luvia through WhatsApp or Instagram for product enquiries.

## Primary page

- [Luvia handmade crochet catalogue](https://singhalgoru.github.io/croche-catalogue/): Browse current handmade crochet products, featured items and new arrivals.

## Official social profile

- [Luvia on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/luvia.craftedwithlove/): Official social profile and product updates.
